title: Jeffrey Kripal's night experience sharing a room with Whitley Strieber at Esalen

tellings.quote: Jeffrey Kriel um who co-authored a book with Whitley tells about the time they shared a room together at the Eselin Institute and uh in the middle of the night Jeffrey had this experience and all he could think was oh my god like this is real and it's happening now

plain: The religion scholar Jeffrey Kripal is said to have had a strange experience in the middle of the night while sharing a room with Whitley Strieber, a writer known for his accounts of visits by unknown beings, at the Esalen Institute, a retreat centre in California. All Kripal could think, the story goes, was "oh my god, this is real and it's happening now." The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove tells Michels this as Kripal's own account, and it matters because it would mean a sceptical scholar felt for himself what Strieber describes.
